measurement_basis.round_noise_policy: Use recorded p95 observations to describe noise. A metric gates only after three observations; its absolute threshold is the larger of the maximum observed p95 times 1.5 and the owner target.
measurement_basis.calibration: Each benchmark execution decodes the same 68-byte in-memory PNG 100000 times per calibration sample with QImage.fromData; payload SHA-256 is 431ced6916a2a21a156e38701afe55bbd7f88969fbbfc56d7fe099d47f265460.
measurement_basis.workload: Production LayeredFullBodyRenderer and LayeredParametricFaceRenderer with the shipped official blue-white Hanfu outfit and classic makeup. Full-body cold starts a fresh renderer and clears QPixmapCache; hot switches warm both endpoints before timing; half-body switches cheek-rest to front-crossed after both are warm.
measurement_basis.scope: Offscreen compositor calls only; excludes the UI event loop, adapter publication, and unrelated window layout work.

sample_policy.sample_unit: One recorded aggregate p95 observation per independent benchmark execution; --record appends exactly one observation per execution.
sample_policy.insufficient_sample_behavior: Record the observation and its spread, print that the metric is not gated because samples are insufficient, and do not compare the runtime value against a threshold.

environment.label: Developer known hardware
environment.description: The recorded Windows development workstation. A non-CI run must match every field below; otherwise the test fails closed.

measurement.source: Fresh local calibrated baseline run in this worktree. Metric histories contain one aggregate p95 observation for this independent execution; round p95 values remain in each record as raw evidence.

calibration.gate_floor_source: Observed during a reduced developer gate-validation run with 5 composition samples and 1 composition round; retained as historical calibration evidence, not as a new metric threshold.
calibration.method: Five rounds of five samples; each sample decodes the fixed in-memory PNG 100000 times.

developer_known_hardware.margin_policy: Each metric uses its own recorded p95 history. With at least three observations, the absolute threshold is max(maximum observed p95 x 1.5, owner target); the normalized ratio retains the same 1.5x observed-noise policy when paired calibration observations exist.

absolute_gate.reason: The seeded baseline is one independent execution; every metric remains record-only until its own history reaches three executions.

cold_full_body.margin: The maximum observed p95 receives a 1.5x noise margin; the owner target is selected when it is looser.
cold_full_body.reason: insufficient samples: sample_count=1 < 3; record only until more independent benchmark executions are captured with --record.

hot_full_body_view_switch.margin: The maximum observed p95 receives a 1.5x noise margin; the owner target is selected when it is looser.
hot_full_body_view_switch.reason: insufficient samples: sample_count=1 < 3; record only until more independent benchmark executions are captured with --record.

hot_half_body_silhouette_switch.margin: The maximum observed p95 receives a 1.5x noise margin; the owner target is selected when it is looser.
hot_half_body_silhouette_switch.reason: insufficient samples: sample_count=1 < 3; record only until more independent benchmark executions are captured with --record.

environment.label: CI runner
environment.description: A hosted CI runner identified by GITHUB_ACTIONS=true or CI=true. The runner's absolute speed is not assumed to match the development workstation.

measurement.source: PR #170 failed Windows CI log; only the retry's cold_full_body p95 is available.

calibration.method: Measured at runtime in the same benchmark execution; no calibration output was persisted by the failed historical run.

ci_runner.margin_policy: CI observations are recorded per metric. A metric with fewer than three persisted observations is explicitly record-only; once it reaches three, its threshold is max(maximum observed p95 x 1.5, owner target), with the paired normalized ratio retained when calibration samples are available.

absolute_gate.reason: The captured CI history has fewer than three observations for every metric, so no CI metric is currently eligible to gate.

ratio_threshold.selection: not established until paired calibration samples exist

cold_full_body.margin: The observation is record-only until three observations exist; no threshold comparison is made.
cold_full_body.reason: insufficient samples: sample_count=1 < 3; record only until more independent benchmark executions are captured with --record.

ratio_threshold.selection: not established until paired calibration samples exist

hot_full_body_view_switch.margin: The observation is record-only until three observations exist; no threshold comparison is made.
hot_full_body_view_switch.reason: insufficient samples: sample_count=0 < 3; record only until more independent benchmark executions are captured with --record.

ratio_threshold.selection: not established until paired calibration samples exist

hot_half_body_silhouette_switch.margin: The observation is record-only until three observations exist; no threshold comparison is made.
hot_half_body_silhouette_switch.reason: insufficient samples: sample_count=0 < 3; record only until more independent benchmark executions are captured with --record.

ci_gate.profile_selection: GITHUB_ACTIONS=true or CI=true selects ci_runner; otherwise the benchmark environment must exactly match developer_known_hardware. Any other state fails closed.
ci_gate.comparison: For every metric whose persisted record has gating=true, observed measurements.*.summary.p95_ms must be <= threshold.absolute_budget_ms and its same-run normalized ratio must be <= ratio_budget. A gating=false record is printed as not gated because samples are insufficient and remains record-only.
ci_gate.absolute_ci_record_only_reason: Each CI metric remains record-only until its own persisted history reaches three observations; this prevents a single hosted-run observation from becoming a gate.
fail_closed_conditions: missing ratio threshold for a metric that is eligible to gate
calibration or compositor sample count below minimum_runtime_samples
absolute p95 or normalized ratio above the recorded noise threshold
ci_gate.cold_over_target_is_not_a_pass: cold_full_body remains over_target=true and is only a regression ceiling until the compositor is improved on a separate authorized change.
